rationale: Y independently reconstructs the ground-truth Low concern almost exactly (finding #4: inconsistent async_chunk fallback defaults between two call sites) and digs deeper into the Med scoping concern by tracing the WebSocket streaming path and a list-vs-tensor consumer mismatch that X never touches, while also flagging the red AMD CI gate. X spends much of its output re-stating the same already-resolved qwen3_tts scoping fact in four near-duplicate bullets, and never engages the flag-default or model-placement threads from the ground truth, though its NPU-parity and CI-dependency findings are valid and well-cited. Neither candidate frames a multi-axis batch-splitting concern in the terms the latent-gap check requires, so gap_hit is false for both.
